s1.syndrome_frame: Gradually enlarging soft-tissue mass over the dorsum of the hand with a history of prior malignancy
salient_findings: 2-month history of a gradually enlarging mass
Soft-tissue mass over the second metacarpal dorsum with mild tenderness
Presence of Reed–Sternberg–like cells in an inflammatory background
key_facts: 25-year-old man
History of Hodgkin lymphoma
Diagnosed with Hodgkin lymphoma 6 years earlier
Received 13 courses of chemotherapy
Mass located over the dorsum of the left hand
Mass measures approximately 4 cm in greatest dimension
Mild tenderness but no limitation of movement
Microscopic examination shows a mixture of inflammatory cells and myxoid stroma
Presence of epithelioid and spindle-shaped cells, lipoblast-like cells, and occasional Reed–Sternberg–like cells

differentials: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue
per_call: Giant cell tumor of soft tissue

shortlist.label: Myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical presentation of a gradually enlarging soft-tissue mass with a mixture of inflammatory cells and myxoid stroma

shortlist.label: Acral myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Specific subtype of myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma that matches the acral location of the mass

shortlist.label: Myxoid liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of myxoid stroma and lipoblast-like cells in the microscopic examination

shortlist.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical presentation of a soft-tissue mass with a mixture of inflammatory cells

shortlist.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of Hodgkin lymphoma and presence of Reed-Sternberg-like cells in the microscopic examination

raw.rationale: The mass is located over the dorsum of the hand, which is a characteristic location for acral myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma, and the microscopic examination shows a mixture of inflammatory cells, myxoid stroma, and Reed–Sternberg–like cells, consistent with this diagnosis

rejected.label: Myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma
rejected.why: While similar, the specific location on the hand makes acral myxoinflammatory fibroblastic sarcoma more specific

rejected.label: Myxoid liposarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of specific liposarcoma features and presence of Reed–Sternberg–like cells

rejected.label: Inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor
rejected.why: The presence of myxoid stroma and Reed–Sternberg–like cells is not typical for this tumor

rejected.label: Hodgkin lymphoma
rejected.why: The patient's history of Hodgkin lymphoma and the presence of Reed–Sternberg–like cells could suggest recurrence, but the clinical and microscopic features are more consistent with a soft tissue tumor
